hook_patterns.name: nobody tells you
hook_patterns.description: Open by promising a hidden truth about a common experience, then state it bluntly in the next sentence.
examples: Nobody tells you this about raising money.

hook_patterns.name: shocking decision + payoff
hook_patterns.description: First line is an unusual action the creator took, second half is the result.
examples: I fired myself for a week and it saved the company.

hook_patterns.name: redefine the word
hook_patterns.description: Negate the common definition of a familiar problem, then give the real one.

on_screen_text_style: 2-3 words that restate the hook, shown in the first second, lowercase, with one line reused as the punchline.
caption_formula: one lowercase sentence that teases the clip, no emoji, 2-3 niche hashtags.
takeaways: Open with the claim, never with context.
Put the hook on screen in 2-3 words within the first second.
